customManagers.description: BuildStream elements: any value annotated with a '# renovate:' comment on the preceding line. Covers `<tool>_version:` variables, `track:` pins and pinned tarball URLs.
Pinned Python dependencies for the catalog / verify workflows (.github/requirements/verify.txt). Matches `dep==version` lines; the required validation job checks the accompanying hashes.

qemu-downloads.description: qemu-img tracks the release tarballs on download.qemu.org, not the GitLab tags. Upstream creates the vX.Y.Z tag before the tarball is published, so a gitlab-tags proposal makes `bst source track` fail with HTTP 404 until the tarball lands. Scraping the download index only ever proposes a version that can actually be fetched.

packageRules.description: Third-party GitHub Actions updates use a three-day minimum release age before Renovate automerges them; pin and digest updates have Renovate's documented timestamp limitations.
First-party GitHub Actions updates can automerge without a release-age delay.

Upstream software pinned in BuildStream elements. Renovate does not automerge these updates; the ref-refresh workflow updates source refs, required checks validate the PR, and Build images runs after merge. The hive can merge Renovate PRs without a binding human review.

Pinned PyPI packages in .github/requirements/*.txt. Renovate does not automerge these updates, but the hive can merge them; the required validation job rejects stale hashes. Regenerate the complete hash-locked requirements as described in docs/skills/ci-tooling/SKILL.md before merging.
kubectl follows the Kubernetes release cadence; skip pre-releases.
Renovate does not automerge GitHub Actions majors. The hive's trusted-bot merge policy is independent of this setting.
